technical.summary: CDNS shows oversold technicals with early reversal signals (RSI/Stoch cross-up) but lacks confirmation from momentum, trend strength, and volume; price remains below all key moving averages with negative CMF suggesting institutional selling pressure.

fundamental.summary: CDNS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 12 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed (junior member with recent sales offsetting older purchase) and lacks conviction; no recent news sentiment available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (344.6) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, CPI event in 1 day adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 12 days create binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI/Stoch oversold with early cross-up signals and extreme fear sentiment (19/100) create contrarian entry opportunity near support at 145.1 with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), lack of confirmation from volume/momentum/trend strength, price below all major moving averages, high earnings risk in 12 days, and negative CMF indicating institutional distribution make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI/Stoch oversold with early cross-up signals present contrarian opportunity, and extreme fear (19/100) creates technical setup near support. However, severe macro headwinds, lack of volume/momentum confirmation, and high earnings risk in 12 days make conviction insufficient for entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 12 days combined with inverted yield curve recession signals and VIX crisis levels create uncontrollable volatility that could gap through support regardless of technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show oversold setup but fundamental, sentiment, and risk agents all flag high-conviction bearish macro environment that overrides technical signals
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration in IT and no existing CDNS position; portfolio drawdown at 0% allows full sizing, but macro severity and earnings proximity warrant avoidance rather than reduced sizing.
